clue.text: Name a fungus that's set back nut-tree

indicators.note: set back means the whole string of name, a and fungus is read in reverse order

parts.note: a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcini

explanation.surface: A mycologist identifies a fungus that has damaged a nut-tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set back' turns N + A + CEP into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This hickory relative of the southern US grows the familiar nut and is named after it.

clue.text: Right to escape all military coups in new state?

definitions.text: Right to escape all military coups in new state?

indicators.note: in new state means the letters of the phrase are rearranged, once the right has escaped them

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Freedom to flee coups by settling in another country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to escape' takes R out of ALL MILITARY COUPS; 'in new state' rearranges what is left. The whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A refugee from persecution is granted protection by a foreign government under this legal status.

clue.text: Arrangement of bars on Fourth of July — not open

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the cage sits above the letter that follows

parts.note: a cage is a structure of bars

indicators.note: fourth of means only the fourth letter of July is used

explanation.surface: Bars arranged for Independence Day, and the venue is closed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone guarded and secretive is unwilling to be frank.

clue.text: Contract arrived at by players rather than clubs, for example

definitions.text: Contract arrived at by players rather than clubs, for example

parts.words: Contract arrived at by players rather than clubs, for example
parts.note: not a sports deal but a bridge bid, where clubs is a suit that could have been chosen as master suit

explanation.definitionFit: In bridge a bid with no master suit, instead of nominating clubs or another suit.

clue.text: Blow up it as ordered, needing 14 inflated

parts.note: to bomb something is to blow it up

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of it as are put into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
the answer at 14 across, read literally, is the opener of the word can, its first letter

explanation.surface: An instruction to explode something as commanded, with some puffed-up rhetoric attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges IT AS into ASTI; the cross-reference to 14 is read as 'can opener', the opening letter of CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflated language is pompous and overblown, exactly what high-flown speech is called.

clue.text: Audibly disapprove of monarch's strict regulations

parts.note: to boo is to make a noise of disapproval out loud
K is the abbreviation for king, a monarch

explanation.surface: Jeering at a king's harsh laws.
explanation.definitionFit: The rules to be followed strictly, as in doing things by the rulebook.

clue.text: As a rule, it's not 'dependent on manpower

definitions.text: As a rule, it's not 'dependent on manpower

parts.words: As a rule, it's not 'dependent on manpower
parts.note: as a rule reads as by rule or government, a system run by women not men

explanation.definitionFit: A society ruled by mothers or women rather than by men.

clue.text: One state's courts subsuming fifty others

indicators.note: subsuming means the courts take in the other piece

parts.note: atria are open courts in Roman houses, plural of atrium
the United States is made up of fifty states

explanation.surface: One nation's law courts absorb fifty more.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alpine republic of Vienna is a nation, a country.

clue.text: They limit goals in a backward area

definitions.meaning: the posts at each side of a goal mark its width
a rural remote place far from civilisation

explanation.definitionFit: Goalposts in sport, and a colloquial term for remote backwoods country.

clue.text: It allows us to make an entrance after the opening number

definitions.text: It allows us to make an entrance after the opening number

parts.words: It allows us to make an entrance after the opening number
parts.note: not a stage show but a safe or door secured by a sequence of digits

explanation.definitionFit: A lock opened by turning dials to a secret numerical sequence.

clue.text: Leaves immediately when it's time to retire

definitions.meaning: to light out is a colloquial way of saying to depart in a hurry
the call in a dormitory or barracks when everyone must go to bed

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both slang for a quick departure and the bedtime signal in a dormitory.

clue.text: Old-fashioned second eleven

parts.note: a cricket or football eleven is a team

explanation.surface: A dated description of a club's reserve side.
explanation.definitionFit: Something from the age of locomotives is jokingly called antiquated, as in steam radio.

clue.text: Score in rugby game, not in test

parts.note: a try is the main way of scoring in rugby
out is the opposite of in

explanation.surface: Touching down in a rugby match, but not in a Test match.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial or audition is a test of someone's ability.

clue.text: Books left one bitter, twisted

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: twisted means the letters of bitter are wrung into another order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned a single sour, twisted person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Books' is the plural of libretto, the text of an opera; 'twisted' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The texts of operas are the words printed in small volumes, so they are called books.

clue.text: Singularly versatile player

parts.note: a musician who plays several instruments at once, all alone

explanation.definitionFit: A street musician playing many instruments at once by themselves.

clue.text: One's required to get some food from person who frees prisoners

definitions.text: One's required to get some food
definitions.meaning: a kitchen tool you need to get at tinned food
in slang a can is a prison, so someone who opens it lets prisoners out

explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen tool for tins, and humorously one who opens the can, a slang word for jail.

clue.text: Name schoolboy embracing wife of a famous mathematician

indicators.note: embracing means the schoolboy holds the wife inside

parts.note: an Etonian is a pupil at Eton College

explanation.surface: Naming a pupil who hugs the wife of a mathematician.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is an English private boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for things relating to Isaac Newton, the physicist who devised calculus.

clue.text: Seas are concealed by 'aze, we hear, in African port

indicators.note: concealed by means the first piece is wrapped inside the second
we hear signals that the dropped-aitch word is taken by its sound

parts.note: haze said without its H sounds like the plural of the letter A
said aloud, these words sound like the letter names C, C and R

explanation.surface: Sea views are hidden by a haze, as a Cockney might say, in an African harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aze is haze with a dropped H, sounding like 'A's', two letter As; inside them go C, C, R, the letter names that 'Seas are' sounds like.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Ghana is a harbour city on the Gulf of Guinea.

clue.text: Police sergeant the equal of gunman?

definitions.meaning: Sergeant ... is Inspector Morse's assistant in the British TV detective series
a light machine gun, so the name stands for a gun, playfully a man's name as a gun

explanation.definitionFit: Morse's sidekick shares a name with a First World War machine gun, so the name both detects and shoots.

clue.text: Yellow material sometimes found in flowers

definitions.text: Yellow material sometimes found in flowers

parts.words: Yellow material sometimes found in flowers
parts.note: not petals but flowers of an element, a fine powder made by sublimation

explanation.definitionFit: A yellow chemical element whose powdered form is called flowers in chemistry.

clue.text: Religious leader and scholar needing his hair restyled

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a degree a scholar holds

indicators.note: restyled means the letters of his hair are dressed in a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A guru and an academic both want a new haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu sage or spiritual teacher is given this title, meaning great seer.

clue.text: Force opponents at bridge repeatedly to produce king

parts.note: to ram is to force

indicators.note: repeatedly means the bridge opponents appear twice

parts.note: E and S, East and South, are opposing seats at bridge

explanation.surface: Bullying bridge opponents again and again to make a king.
explanation.definitionFit: Several Egyptian pharaohs bore this name, monarchs of ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Apart from edges, is now linen, over which it's always white

indicators.note: apart from edges means the outermost letters of is now linen are dropped and the rest is kept

explanation.surface: Linen sheets that, apart from their edges, are permanently white.
explanation.definitionFit: On a mountain, the altitude above which snow lies all year is marked by this boundary.

clue.text: Aggressive female parrot

definitions.meaning: a strong, warlike woman, after the warrior women of Greek myth
a genus of green South American parrots is named after the great river

explanation.definitionFit: A warrior woman of legend, and a type of green parrot from tropical America.

clue.text: Unknown river in renamed African area

parts.note: Z is an unknown in algebra
the Aire is a Yorkshire river

explanation.surface: An unnamed river in a newly renamed region of Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The old name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which was renamed in 1997.

clue.text: Last guy

definitions.meaning: a guy is a rope used to steady a mast or tent

explanation.definitionFit: To endure or remain, and a supporting rope or wire for a mast.

clue.text: Exotic type of garland — article mostly found in a certain port

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian flower garland

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the article is dropped

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A tropical garland and some article turned up at a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: LEITH is the port of Edinburgh, on the Firth of Forth in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Edinburgh's docks district is a well-known Scottish harbour.

clue.text: How to score extremely high

parts.note: not points in a game but a musical score, where a direction tells the player to go to the very top of the range

explanation.definitionFit: This Italian musical term means in the highest register, written in a score.

clue.text: Fellow on island freed by a castaway, finally

definitions.text: Fellow on island freed by a castaway, finally

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the following pieces come after the island

parts.note: the Isle of Man lies in the Irish Sea
rid means freed, as in rid of a burden

indicators.note: finally means only the closing letter of castaway is used

explanation.surface: Defoe's tale of a native companion whom a shipwrecked sailor rescues on his island.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes Robinson Crusoe's servant, rescued by the castaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Crusoe's loyal servant in Defoe's novel, a fellow freed on the island by the shipwrecked hero.

clue.text: Second highest position, say

parts.note: a peak is the top point

explanation.surface: Coming second to the summit, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk or utter words is a synonym for this verb.
